difficulty_reason: The author relates non-idempotent quantitative derivations to effectful stack-machine reduction, proves weighted strong subject reduction, and constructs perpetual evaluation via a lexicographic reduction-length/term-size induction. The converse then reconstructs strong typeability by induction over every perpetual-evaluation case, including the admissible memory typing rules. All original derivations in the extended proof appendices are retained. This is non-routine H2; no H3 upgrade is inferred from the paper venue.
